newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 18.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 18.

text.p: * New York Times Co is expected to report third quarter earnings. First Call consensus forecast is $0.36 per share vs $0.28.
* Tribune Co is expected to report third quarter earnings. First Call consensus is $0.85 vs $0.79.
* U.S. Bancorp is expected to report third quarter earnings. First Call consensus is $0.76 vs $0.79.

* Gillette Co reported third quarter earnings of $0.54 per share, up from $0.46 a year ago. The consensus estimate was $0.53. The company also named Henry Kravis to its board. Shares closed at 73-5/8.
* Reebok International Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.75 per share, down from $0.96 a year ago, and warned of continued pressure on its profit margins in 1997. Shares closed at 33-3/4.
* Iomega Corp reported third quarter earnings after Thursday's close of $0.09 a share versus $0.02 last year. Shares rose 2-1/4 to 25-1/8 in after-hours trade.
* Eskimo Pie Corp reported a third quarter loss of $0.81 per share versus a profit $0.31 a year earlier. Shares closed at 15.
* Ecogen Inc said it does not expect to meet fourth quarter profit estimates. The company cited design flaws in its pesticide-making equipment. Shares closed at 3-3/4.
